questions.question: When King Hezekiah called the people to keep the Passover, what did the power of God give the people of Judah?

answers.text: One heart to obey the king's command
Gold to fill the house of the LORD

questions.question: When King Hezekiah's couriers took his Passover invitation through Ephraim, Manasseh and Zebulun, how did the people treat them?

answers.text: They welcomed them in every city
They arrested them at the gates

questions.question: At Hezekiah's Passover, the king prayed for people who had not purified themselves, and the LORD heard him and healed them. True or false?
At Hezekiah's great Passover celebration in Jerusalem, only the people of Judah rejoiced, and the foreigners were left out. True or false?
